ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota Medicaid fraud scheme, including how the suspect was able to flee the country before trial
questions: How was the suspect able to flee the country before trial?
What was the role of the suspect in the Medicaid fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and identify those responsible. By following the money, we can determine how the suspect was able to profit from the scheme and how they were able to evade law enforcement.
